Hi Rachel,

Thanks for walking us through the Order Form yesterday. Legal flagged a couple of items we want to tidy before countersigning: principally the publicity clause and the reference/quote permissions. Two quick asks so we can finish approvals on our side: 

1) Can you confirm the exact "press quote window" (the period post-launch where Redwood may publish a case study/quote)? Our procurement team thought the MSA/Order Form language left the window unspecified.
2) What evidence or assets do you need from Glimmer to satisfy the publicity clause (logo PNGs, legal signoff, usage notes)?

We're trying to prepare a single package for our legal ops team to review — would like to avoid back-and-forth if possible. Attaching a short checklist we usually provide.

eliza@glimmer.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Eliza Chen <eliza@glimmer.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Oct 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Press quote window + logo use — what do you need from us?

Thanks Eliza — this is helpful. Looping Ben (Sales Ops) and Dev (Legal Ops) so we can be explicit about what the Order Form requires and propose a narrow carve-out if needed. Quick answers below, then a proposal for wording we can include as an Order Form attachment to avoid having to update the MSA itself.

- Press quote window: Redwood typically requests a 90-day window following public launch/announcement to publish a customer quote or case study unless customers request an embargo. We can make that explicit in the Order Form as: "Redwood may publish customer quotes/case studies within 90 days following the customer's public announcement, subject to prior approval."

- Evidence needed: high-res logo (PNG/SVG), a one-line customer-approved quote, link to the public announcement (if already live), and the internal legal point-of-contact for signoff. If you prefer, Glimmer can provide a signed one-page approval instead of a manual signoff each time.

Ben/Dev — two asks: 1) Can you confirm whether a 90-day default is OK from a risk and procurement standpoint? 2) If Glimmer asks for a perpetual reference right (i.e., Redwood may reference Glimmer in materials indefinitely), can we limit that to marketing channels explicitly listed (e.g., website, case studies, blog) and require prior approval for press releases/third-party press?

Proposed attachment to Order Form: "Publicity and Reference Addendum" with the 90-day window, listed channels, approval requirement for press, and logo usage guidance. If that reads OK I can send a draft for legal redline.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Adding a couple of operational notes and attaching a redline for the Order Form addendum. High level: 90 days is fine, but procurement often requests an explicit embargo carve-out for sensitive customers — if Glimmer needs a longer embargo for an upcoming funding announcement, let's capture that in the evidence manifest.

I attached a quick redline (redline_msa_v3.pdf) that:
- Inserts a short "Publicity and References" addendum into the Order Form.
- Lists permitted channels (Website, Case Studies, Blog, Conference collateral, Sales Decks) where we can reference Glimmer without additional signoff once we have the one-line approval.
- Requires explicit prior approval for press releases, third-party press, or partner co-marketing that uses company logos.

If Glimmer wants to keep perpetual reference rights but with a locked list of channels and an easy approval flow, that's something we can accept. Dev — if you see any legal red flags in the attached, please call them out.

Attachment: redline_msa_v3.pdf (PDF — redline of Order Form addendum)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Eliza Chen <eliza@glimmer.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Oct 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Press quote window + logo use — what do you need from us?

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifying points from our side after running this past Legal: 

1) Embargoes: We have a product launch scheduled for Dec 12. Glimmer would prefer a 180-day embargo option for that launch if possible — not a default, but an allowed carve-out we can indicate in the evidence manifest. Is that feasible?
2) Perpetual reference rights: We can agree to perpetual references but would like the "permitted channels" list to explicitly exclude paid third-party promotions and partner co-branded press without separate consent.
3) Approval flow: Our legal ops prefers a one-page signed approval for each piece of collateral rather than a back-and-forth email thread. We attached our evidence manifest — it includes the legal approver and an embargo flag for Dec 12.

Attachment: glimmer_evidence_manifest.xlsx (spreadsheet — includes embargo flag and approver contact)

If possible, could your redline include a sentence that says: "Customer may request an extended embargo (up to 180 days) by indicating the embargo window in the evidence manifest at the time of delivery." That would let procurement accept a 90-day default but honor Glimmer's special-case launch needs.

Best,
Eliza

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Eliza Chen <eliza@glimmer.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Oct 2028 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Press quote window + logo use — what do you need from us?

Thanks everyone — thoughtful notes. Quick summary of legal signoff and next steps: 

1) We can accept the operational model proposed: 90-day default window + optional extended embargo up to 180 days if flagged in the evidence manifest. I will add the sentence Eliza requested into the Order Form addendum.
2) Perpetual reference rights are acceptable provided we enumerate permitted channels and expressly exclude paid third-party placements and co-branded press releases without additional consent.
3) Approval workflow: we'll accept Glimmer's one-page signed approval as sufficient for single collateral items; for press releases we will require a short email chain + solicitor signoff for co-branded PR.

I attached the updated language; Ben, please take a quick look and if you're good, Rachel please send this as an Order Form attachment to Glimmer for countersignature.
